_note: Single source for the book cards on the Book tab (/about/), the Books page (/books/) and the ad slots (ads.js). Edit here, then run: python3 tools/books_render.py. For each book set status to available once it is on sale, and paste the exact Amazon addresses into kindle and paperback. The amazon.com search addresses below are interim stand-ins until the exact product addresses are added. blurb is the equal-length description used on /groups/ (keep each at about 40 words); inside and samples feed its Look inside strip.

books.title: Israel NOWlej
books.subtitle: Know the Story of the Jewish Land in Maps, Timelines, Charts, and Graphics
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: The visual atlas of the Jewish land. Maps, timelines, charts and graphics first, text second: 33 maps, 26 timelines, 13 infographics, 17 rankings, 6 Top Ten lists, A Taste of Israel, and a glossary and index of more than 500 entries. Every page opens online through a QR code, so the book and this site work together.
books.short: 33 maps, 26 timelines, 500+ glossary entries. The visual atlas of the Jewish land.
books.blurb: The whole collection in one volume. Thirty-three maps, twenty-six timelines, thirteen infographics, seventeen rankings and six Top Ten lists, plus A Taste of Israel and a glossary of more than 500 entries. Every page opens online through its QR code.

books.title: Israel in Maps
books.subtitle: Where, When and Why is Zion?
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: The atlas. Thirty-three historical maps from the Patriarchs to the present, each facing a page that explains it, plus size comparisons, population charts and rankings.
books.short: Thirty-three historical maps, each facing a page that explains it.
books.blurb: The atlas. Thirty-three historical maps follow the land from the Patriarchs to the present, and each one faces a page that explains it. Size comparisons, population charts and rankings show how small the country is and how much happened there.

Map: Tensions Before the Six-Day War

books.title: Israel in Time
books.subtitle: Four Thousand Years at a Glance
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: The timelines. Twenty-six timelines from the patriarchs to today, Top Ten lists, reference tables, demographic charts, calendars, a This Day in History, a glossary and an index.
books.short: Twenty-six timelines from the patriarchs to today.
books.blurb: The timelines. Twenty-six timelines run from the patriarchs to today, marking conflict, diplomacy, settlement, faith and the arts. Top Ten lists, reference tables, demographic charts, calendars and a This Day in History complete it, with a glossary and an index.
samples: Timeline: Patriarchs to the First Kings

books.title: Welcome to Zion
books.subtitle: The Land of Israel, 4,000 Years Old and 40 Miles Wide
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: A tour of ten regions and eighty-one sites, from Eilat in the south to the Gaza border. Each site has its own page, picture and short story.
books.short: A tour of ten regions and eighty-one sites.
books.blurb: The tour. Ten regions and eighty-one sites, from Eilat in the south to the Golan Heights in the north and the Gaza border in the west. Every site has its own page, a color picture and a short story that explains why it matters.
